claim: *The upload-entitlement domain.* A user belongs to one or more groups; a group carries either a finite credit balance or unlimited use. The admission decision needs both facts, so a representation that can express only the finite balance cannot answer the question the decision asks.

topology.description: User-group multiplicity; finite/unlimited entitlement alternatives must both feed admission.

bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: A user belongs to one or more groups. The group branches into finite credits and unlimited entitlement. Both alternatives feed an upload decision ending in admit or reject; the decision must preserve both facts. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
